## Load Packages
```{r}
#Clear environment
rm(list = ls())

library(raster)
library(sp)
library(exactextractr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
```


## Read in the Data
```{r}
setwd("/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research")
sites <- read.csv("data/DUG_data - fall_data.csv")

imperv_path <- "data/NLCD_mf5qnksxr8tzfi/Annual_NLCD_FctImp_2024_CU_C1V1_mf5qnksxr8tzfi.tiff"
tcc_path <- "data/NLCD_mf5qnksxr8tzfi/nlcd_tcc_conus_wgs84_v2023-5_20230101_20231231_mf5qnksxr8tzfi.tiff"
nlcd_path <- "data/NLCD_mf5qnt9vt9mx4o/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1_mf5qnt9vt9mx4o.tiff"

# Load rasters into R
tcc_ras <- rast(tcc_path)  # Tree canopy cover raster
imperv_ras <- rast(imperv_path)
nlcd <- rast(nlcd_path)
```

# Extract Raster Data

Extract City Coordinates
```{r}
# Extract city coordinates
garden_coords <- st_as_sf(sites, coords = c("Long", "Lat"), crs = 4326) # Use EPSG 4326 for WGS84
```

Extract Raster CRS
```{r}
# Force imperv_ras into the same CRS as tcc_ras
imperv_ras <- project(imperv_ras, tcc_ras)
nlcd_ras <- project(nlcd_ras, tcc_ras)

# Save the CRS of the rasters
crs_rasters <- crs(tcc_ras)
```

Extract mean raster values within each buffer
```{r}
# Create a buffer around sites
buffer_radius <- c(200, 500, 1000)  # set to desired buffer size (in meters)

# Function to extract summed raster values for buffers
extract_raster_mean <- function(raster, buffers) {
  extracted_values <- terra::extract(raster, as(buffers, "SpatVector"), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  extracted_values[, 2]  # summed values in second column
}

for (i in buffer_radius) {
  # create buffer of radius i
  garden_buffer <- st_transform(
    st_buffer(st_transform(garden_coords, crs_rasters), dist = i),
    crs_rasters
  )
  
  # dynamic column names
  tcc_col <- paste0("tcc", i, "m")
  imp_col <- paste0("imp", i, "m")
  
  # extract and save into dataframe
  sites[[tcc_col]] <- extract_raster_mean(tcc_ras, garden_buffer)
  sites[[imp_col]] <- extract_raster_mean(imperv_ras, garden_buffer)
}
```

# Land Cover Classes Code
```{r}
## --------------------------------------------------
## Inputs
## --------------------------------------------------
# Load NLCD raster (RasterLayer)
nlcd <- raster("/Users/aska1693/Downloads/Chapter3_DUGresearch/dug-research/data/NLCD_mf5qnt9vt9mx4o/Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1_mf5qnt9vt9mx4o.tiff")

# Load site coordinates: data frame with site_code, lon, lat
# Replace 'sites' with your actual data frame
# Convert to SpatialPointsDataFrame
coordinates(sites) <- ~Long+Lat
proj4string(sites) <- CRS("+init=epsg:4326")  # WGS84

# Reproject sites to NLCD CRS
sites <- sp::spTransform(sites, crs(nlcd))

## --------------------------------------------------
## Buffer sizes (meters)
## --------------------------------------------------
buffer_sizes <- c(200, 500, 1000)

## --------------------------------------------------
## Function: extract NLCD and calculate proportions
## --------------------------------------------------
extract_nlcd_buffer <- function(buffer_m, sites, nlcd) {
  
  # Convert SpatialPointsDataFrame to SpatVector
  sites_vect <- terra::vect(sites)
  
  # Create buffers
  buffers_vect <- terra::buffer(sites_vect, width = buffer_m)
  
  # Convert back to Spatial* object for exactextractr
  buffers_sp <- as(buffers_vect, "Spatial")
  
  # Extract NLCD values
  exact_list <- exact_extract(nlcd, buffers_sp)
  
  # Combine into tibble with site codes
  df <- map2_dfr(exact_list, sites$site_code, function(vals, site) {
    tibble(
      site_code = site,
      nlcd = vals$value
    )
  })
  
  # Collapse NLCD codes and compute proportions
  df %>%
    mutate(
      lc_group = case_when(
        nlcd == 11 ~ "water",
        nlcd %in% c(21, 22) ~ "dev_low",
        nlcd %in% c(23, 24) ~ "dev_high",
        nlcd %in% c(41, 42, 43) ~ "forest",
        nlcd %in% c(52, 71) ~ "shrub_grass",
        nlcd %in% c(81, 82) ~ "agriculture",
        nlcd %in% c(90, 95) ~ "wetland",
        nlcd == 31 ~ "barren",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(lc_group)) %>%
    group_by(site_code, lc_group) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(site_code) %>%
    mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(buffer_label = paste0(lc_group, buffer_m, "m")) %>%
    dplyr::select(site_code, buffer_label, prop)
}

## --------------------------------------------------
## Run extraction for all buffer sizes
## --------------------------------------------------
landcover_list <- map(buffer_sizes, ~ extract_nlcd_buffer(.x, sites, nlcd))
landcover_all <- bind_rows(landcover_list)

## --------------------------------------------------
## Pivot to wide format (one row per site)
## --------------------------------------------------
landcover_wide <- landcover_all %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = buffer_label,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0
  )

## --------------------------------------------------
## Join to site-level dataset
## --------------------------------------------------
sites_data_full <- left_join(sites, landcover_wide, by = "site_code")

# Check the result
head(sites_data_full)

colnames(landcover_wide)
```
